target_customer: Marketers at direct-to-consumer brands such as Betabrand, Outdoor Voices, Everlane and Jack Erwin
problem: Marketers spend time wrangling visit, conversion and spend data across channels and devices and lack accurate multi-touch attribution to allocate spend.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for marketing analytics (pricing not found)

founders.name: Jamie Quint
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as later Head of Growth at Notion, led growth and monetization at Reddit, and now General Partner at Uncommon Capital; the page does not date these roles so they are not recorded as prior employers.

founders.name: Amir Ghazvinian
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CTO with no background.

exit.reason: Not stated; Crunchbase labels the company closed with no date or reason, and no acquisition was found.

competitors.name: Adtriba
competitors.what: Multi-touch attribution modeling and advertising insights platform from Germany
competitors.funding_then: Seed round of $866K dated May 2016 per PitchBook

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires integrations with many ad and commerce platforms and deterministic cross-device syncing of spend and conversions, plus attribution models. Standard data engineering with some hard identity matching.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and historical data create some stickiness, but attribution vendors were many and ad platforms could expand their own reporting.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Platforms and analytics vendors added their own multi-touch tools, for example AppsFlyer launched multi-touch tracking. A 2020s postmortem notes many B2B attribution vendors pivoted, disappeared or were acquired.

market_need_then: The company's own customers were DTC brands with multi-channel spend. Last-click attribution was widely criticized in 2016 (AppsFlyer called it 'a big lie'). No survey or budget data from 2016 was found.

branding.domain_note: Used interstateanalytics.com; the domain now hosts an unrelated sports news site.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain B2B copy about helping marketers make smarter decisions.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community coverage found. 'Interstate' plus 'Analytics' is generic, and other companies named Interstate appear in funding databases and searches.

outcome_analysis: Interstate Analytics was a two founder Winter 2016 multi-touch attribution startup with DTC brand customers and apparently no outside funding. Crunchbase marks it closed but no post-mortem or cause was found, so failure factors are left empty. The attribution category was crowded and ad platforms were building their own tools, but no source ties that to this company's end.
notes: Funding: Crunchbase lists only placeholder pre-seed rows with no amount or investor; Latka lists $0 funding and $615.4K revenue, an aggregator estimate. A YC batch alone is not recorded as a round. Website interstateanalytics.com now serves an unrelated sports site, so the company site is dead. Competitor Adtriba is the only rival with a source dated near the batch (PitchBook, seen through search results only); Rockerbox and others had no dated source near 2016. YC lists both founders as former founders.
